rationale_one_line: All eight presets are inside the 14-entry anti-repeat window, so a brand pack is required. Cohere is an enterprise retrieval and agent-infrastructure brand whose identity is a near-black agent-console field with white type and a single coral editorial accent. semble is CPU-only retrieval built for coding agents, so the Cohere command-center surface and RECEIPT (numbers do the proving) frame the efficiency story without hype.
writing_tone_notes: Peer-to-peer build-in-public engineer voice. Calm, declarative, restrained, research-lab cadence. The numbers carry the praise, never superlatives. Contractions where natural. Coral is a single accent on near-black, never a fill. State the grep-to-retrieval contrast as fact, not opinion.
do_rules: Lead the receipt with the 98%-fewer-tokens-than-grep-and-read number as the first big hit.
Follow with the 11x-faster-than-a-transformer-index number as the second hit.
Land the so-what as the loudest beat: stop grepping, start retrieving.
Keep the 'semble' held-subject wordmark anchored across every scene.
Use the fade register and one coral accent so it reads as a sober command center, not a launch hype cut.
dont_rules: Don't repeat the X caption's phrasing (Hacker News momentum, code search written for coding agents, CPU only, no API) in any scene or in the Why-this-one.
Don't name Model2Vec or cite NDCG 0.854 or the 50x/500x lineage numbers in scene copy — those belong only to the Why-this-one.
Don't use a version number anywhere.
Don't flood the frame with coral — it's a single accent on near-black, never a fill.
